# IKChain

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/agents/ik.h`](../../../src/logic/agents/ik.h) · Described in `data/agents_motion.json`

A chain of a rig's joints from root to tip, solved by Fabrik; one entity per chain.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `rig` | `entt::entity` | the rig entity (Rig + RigPose) (default entt::null) |
| `name` | `std::string` | for logs and views ("left leg", "right arm") |
| `joints` | `std::vector<int>` | joint indices root to tip, each one's child the next one's parent; the target position is for the last joint's anchor |
| `pole_rest` | `glm::vec3` | where the inner joints point at the rest pose (zero: no pole) (default glm::vec3(0.0)) |
| `limits` | `bool` | clamp to the rig model's joint limits (default true) |
| `yield` | `bool` | with limits: when the tip then misses its target by more than 0.5 mm or 0.2 degrees, solve again without them (default false) |
| `solved` | `bool` | the chain had enabled targets and was solved on the last tick (default false) |
| `iterations` | `int` | FABRIK iterations of the last solve (default 0) |
| `position_error` | `float` | m between the tip anchor and the target, last solve (default 0.0) |
| `rotation_error` | `float` | radians between the tip segment and the target, last solve (default 0.0) |
| `limit_excess` | `float` | radians the limits took away, or would have (yielded), the worst joint (default 0.0) |
| `yielded` | `bool` | the limits gave way on this solve (default false) |

## Notes

Entities created by GaitFootIK (legs) and GaitHandIK (arms), destroyed by GaitRoutes at a new route (legs). Fabrik writes the last-solve fields; GaitBalance and GaitChecks read them.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: GaitBalance, GaitChecks. Written by: Fabrik, GaitFootIK, GaitHandIK. Created by: GaitFootIK, GaitHandIK. Destroyed by: GaitRoutes.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Fabrik](../systems/Fabrik.md) | system | World | **readwrite** | tick | joints, rest pole, limits and yield read; the solve's results written |
| [GaitBalance](../systems/GaitBalance.md) | system | World | **read** | tick | the legs' and arms' joints, poles, limits, yield |
| [GaitChecks](../systems/GaitChecks.md) | system | World | **read** | tick | residuals, limit excess, yielded, solved |
| [GaitFootIK](../systems/GaitFootIK.md) | system | World | **write+create** | tick | the legs' chain entities created on the first tick; yield set every tick |
| [GaitHandIK](../systems/GaitHandIK.md) | system | World | **write+create** | tick | the arms' chain entities created the first time scrambling is on; yield set every tick |
| [GaitRoutes](../systems/GaitRoutes.md) | system | World | **destroy** | start | the legs' chain entities of the old gait destroyed |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[Fabrik](../systems/Fabrik.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[GaitBalance](../systems/GaitBalance.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[GaitChecks](../systems/GaitChecks.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[GaitFootIK](../systems/GaitFootIK.md)**
  - Creates two IK chain entities and two IK target entities on the first tick of a gait.
- **[GaitHandIK](../systems/GaitHandIK.md)**
  - Creates two IK chain entities and two IK target entities the first time scrambling is on.
- **[GaitRoutes](../systems/GaitRoutes.md)**
  - Destroys the old legs' IK chain and target entities at each new route (the arms' ones, if any, are left behind).
  - Logs a warning when no route in the slope band is found.
